Project Name: GDP (Great Discount Place) App
Technical Stack: Python, FastAPI, JWT, Redis, AWS S3, MongoDB, RESTful APIs, JSON, Agile Methodology, React.js, Next.js, Android, iOS
Duration: JUN 2025 – Present
Project Description:
The GDP (Great Discount Place) App is a mobile-first discount discovery platform available on Android and iOS, designed to provide users with exclusive deals across various product categories. Users can browse category-wise offers, view nearby discounts, and access limited-time promotions. The platform supports both user and merchant roles with a secure login system, and provides an admin dashboard for managing deals, users, and merchants. Key integrations include OTP-based login, JWT authentication, Redis for performance optimization, AWS S3 for media storage, and MongoDB for dynamic data management. An intuitive web-based frontend admin panel was developed using React.js and Next.js to simplify backend operations.
Responsibilities:
• API Development: Designed and developed RESTful APIs using FastAPI for user registration, merchant onboarding, offer listings, and deal redemptions.
• Authentication & Security: Implemented JWT-based authentication and role-based access control for users, merchants, and admin roles.
• Email OTP Login: Integrated secure email-based OTP login system for user and merchant authentication.
• Frontend Admin Panel: Built an interactive admin dashboard using React.js and Next.js to manage users, merchants, categories, and offers.
• Redis Caching: Used Redis for API caching, session management, and performance optimization.
• File Uploads: Integrated AWS S3 for uploading and retrieving discount banners, product images, and merchant documents.
• Mobile Compatibility: Ensured API support for Android and iOS apps, enabling seamless user experience across devices.
• Database Management: Used MongoDB to manage user profiles, merchant data, category structures, and discount metadata.
• Error Handling: Applied FastAPI’s global exception handling to maintain consistent error reporting and user-friendly responses.
• Agile Practices: Followed Agile methodology for sprint planning and iterative development; used GitHub for version control and collaborative tracking.
Project Name: QI News Platform
Technical Stack: Python, FastAPI, JWT, Redis, AWS S3, MongoDB, RESTful APIs, JSON, Agile Methodology
Duration: Personal Project – Mar 2025 to JUN 2025
Project Description:
The QI News Platform is a subscription-based news application that delivers category-wise articles to registered users. Users can log in to access both free and paid articles, with premium content restricted to subscribers. The platform includes admin login functionality for article management and user administration. Key features include API-based authentication using JWT, Redis for caching and validation, email OTP-based login for secure access, and AWS S3 integration for managing article-related file uploads.
Responsibilities:
Develop RESTful APIs: Design and implement scalable APIs using FastAPI to support user and admin functionalities, including category-wise article retrieval and subscription management.
Authentication and Security: Implement JWT-based authentication and role-based access control for secure access to paid and free articles.
Email OTP Login: Develop an OTP-based email login system to provide secure and seamless user authentication.
Caching and Validation: Use Redis to optimize API performance through caching and session validation.
Paid Article Access: Design APIs to differentiate between free and paid content, ensuring secure access for premium subscribers.
Admin Panel APIs: Create APIs for admin users to manage articles, categories, and user subscriptions.
File Uploads: Integrate AWS S3 to handle file uploads, including article images and related assets.
Database Design: Use MongoDB for managing user profiles, subscriptions, and article metadata efficiently.
Error Handling: Implement global exception handling using FastAPI to ensure smooth error management.
Agile Development: Apply Agile methodology to manage iterative development cycles and use GitHub for version control and collaboration
Project Name: Self-Learning Platform  (DIY)
Technical Stack: Python, FastAPI, JWT, Redis, AWS S3, MongoDB, RESTful APIs, JSON, Agile Methodology
Duration: Personal Project – DEC 2024 to Mar 2025
Project Description:
The Self-Learning Platform is a comprehensive system designed for students and colleges to streamline learning and internship management. The platform includes a student login, admin (college) login, category-wise internship assignments, and week-wise task tracking. Key features include API-based authentication using JWT, caching and validation using Redis, and email OTP-based login for enhanced security. The platform also integrates AWS S3 for efficient file uploads.
Responsibilities:
Develop RESTful APIs: Build robust and scalable APIs using FastAPI to support student and admin functionalities.
Authentication and Security: Implement JWT-based authentication and role-based access control to secure user data and application endpoints.
Email OTP Login: Create an OTP-based email login system for user authentication, ensuring a secure and user-friendly experience.
Caching and Validation: Use Redis to manage caching, session management, and validation for faster API responses.
Task and Internship Management: Design APIs to categorize internships and assign week-wise tasks for student progress tracking.
File Uploads: Integrate AWS S3 for secure and efficient file storage, including resume and task submission uploads.
Database Design: Use MongoDB to design and maintain database schemas for user profiles, tasks, and internship details.
Error Handling: Implement global exception handling for graceful error management using FastAPI exception handlers.
DevOps Practices: Use Agile principles for iterative development and implement version control through GitHub.

Project Name: GDP (Great Discount Place) App
Technical Stack: Python, FastAPI, JWT, Redis, AWS S3, MongoDB, RESTful APIs, JSON, Agile Methodology, React.js, Next.js, Android, iOS
Duration: JUN 2025 – Present
Project Description:

The GDP (Great Discount Place) App is a mobile-first discount discovery platform available on Android and iOS, designed to provide users with exclusive deals across various product categories. Users can browse category-wise offers, view nearby discounts, and access limited-time promotions. The platform supports both user and merchant roles with a secure login system, and provides an admin dashboard for managing deals, users, and merchants. Key integrations include OTP-based login, JWT authentication, Redis for performance optimization, AWS S3 for media storage, and MongoDB for dynamic data management. An intuitive web-based frontend admin panel was developed using React.js and Next.js to simplify backend operations.
Responsibilities:
• API Development: Designed and developed RESTful APIs using FastAPI for user registration, merchant onboarding, offer listings, and deal redemptions.
• Authentication & Security: Implemented JWT-based authentication and role-based access control for users, merchants, and admin roles.
• Email OTP Login: Integrated secure email-based OTP login system for user and merchant authentication.
• Frontend Admin Panel: Built an interactive admin dashboard using React.js and Next.js to manage users, merchants, categories, and offers.
• Redis Caching: Used Redis for API caching, session management, and performance optimization.
• File Uploads: Integrated AWS S3 for uploading and retrieving discount banners, product images, and merchant documents.
• Mobile Compatibility: Ensured API support for Android and iOS apps, enabling seamless user experience across devices.
• Database Management: Used MongoDB to manage user profiles, merchant data, category structures, and discount metadata.
• Error Handling: Applied FastAPI’s global exception handling to maintain consistent error reporting and user-friendly responses.
• Agile Practices: Followed Agile methodology for sprint planning and iterative development; used GitHub for version control and collaborative tracking.
Project Name: QI News Platform

Project Description:

The QI News Platform is a subscription-based news application that delivers category-wise articles to registered users. Users can log in to access both free and paid articles, with premium content restricted to subscribers. The platform includes admin login functionality for article management and user administration. Key features include API-based authentication using JWT, Redis for caching and validation, email OTP-based login for secure access, and AWS S3 integration for managing article-related file uploads.
Responsibilities:
Develop RESTful APIs: Design and implement scalable APIs using FastAPI to support user and admin functionalities, including category-wise article retrieval and subscription management.
Authentication and Security: Implement JWT-based authentication and role-based access control for secure access to paid and free articles.
Email OTP Login: Develop an OTP-based email login system to provide secure and seamless user authentication.
Caching and Validation: Use Redis to optimize API performance through caching and session validation.
Paid Article Access: Design APIs to differentiate between free and paid content, ensuring secure access for premium subscribers.
Admin Panel APIs: Create APIs for admin users to manage articles, categories, and user subscriptions.
File Uploads: Integrate AWS S3 to handle file uploads, including article images and related assets.
Database Design: Use MongoDB for managing user profiles, subscriptions, and article metadata efficiently.
Error Handling: Implement global exception handling using FastAPI to ensure smooth error management.
Agile Development: Apply Agile methodology to manage iterative development cycles and use GitHub for version control and collaboration
